cabin_voxels.note: proof loads hull, turret, gun and cupola lid meshes only; the game's roof lids and visor shutters are absent here, so their openings are open

model.engine: direction from the engine compartment; inside, lateral retention sqrt(direct share) and the Hopkinson-Stryker level offset with R = 12 m2 [E]
model.foley: acoustics::foley contact synthesis, levels from each cue's 1 m reference through sound_propagation
model.rooms: acoustics::raytrace stochastic energy ray tracing per octave band, Tiger source triangles voxelized at 5 cm, snow ground, brick boxes; binaural IR from the echogram
